Preprocess Illumina 10X Genomics GEX / antibody capture data by sample - from Cell Ranger per-sample filtered matrix

+ CITE-seq: cell-surface protein measurements
+ Cell Hashing: tagged antibodies against ubiquitous cell surface proteins to multiplex samples

Code adapted from:

+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/hashing_vignette
+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/multimodal_vignette
+ Meijie/Shaoli code (CCRGB-42)
+ https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dsb/vignettes/end_to_end_workflow.html

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dsb)
```

# Create Seurat object

## Get h5 file location

```{r}
library <- params$library
input_dir <- params$input_dir
output_dir <- params$output_dir
sample <- params$sample

h5_filtered <- paste(input_dir,library,"outs/per_sample_outs/",sample,"/count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",sep="/")

print(paste("Using input file:", h5_filtered))
```

## Load h5 data

Assumes data includes only shared barcodes

```{r}
sample.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_filtered)

# Simplify feature names
rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_*TotalSeqC", replacement = "",rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
```

## Create Seurat object 

Initialize with RNA, add ADT assay 

```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sample.data[["Gene Expression"]],project=sample)
seurat_obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]][5:22,])
```

# Normalize data 

Log normalization for RNA, CLR transformation for antibodies

+ CITE-seq: margin=2 for normalization within the cell, accounting for differences in ADT depth across cells (https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/8159)
* Overwritten by DSB normalization

```{r}
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
```

# ADT normalization with DSB

Removes ambient noise using empty droplets and uses non-specific isotype controls to remove inter-cell technical variation.

Get background cells from raw matrix

```{r}
h5_raw <- paste(input_dir,library,"outs/multi/count/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",sep="/")
library.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_raw)

# Simplify feature names
rownames(library.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_*TotalSeqC", replacement = "",rownames(library.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))

cell_barcodes = read.csv(paste(input_dir,library,"outs/multi/multiplexing_analysis/assignment_confidence_table.csv",sep="/"))$Barcode
background_barcodes = setdiff(colnames(library.data[["Gene Expression"]]), cell_barcodes)

seurat_obj.background <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = library.data[["Gene Expression"]][,background_barcodes],project=library)
seurat_obj.background[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = library.data[["Antibody Capture"]][5:22,background_barcodes])
```

```{r}
isotypes = c("Mm-IgG1-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2a-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2b-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl")

seurat_obj[["ADT"]]$data = DSBNormalizeProtein(cell_protein_matrix = seurat_obj[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     empty_drop_matrix = seurat_obj.background[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     denoise.counts = TRUE, 
                                     use.isotype.control = TRUE, 
                                     isotype.control.name.vec = isotypes,
                                     fast.km = TRUE)
```

# GEX QC and filtering

```{r}
seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")

print(paste("Cells pre-filtering:",length(colnames(seurat_obj))))
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
hist(seurat_obj$nFeature_RNA)
hist(seurat_obj$percent.mt)

# Filter
print(paste("Number of genes:",params$nFeature_RNA_min,"-",params$nFeature_RNA_max))
print(paste("% MT:",params$percent.mt_max))

seurat_obj.filtered <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > params$nFeature_RNA_min & 
                                        nFeature_RNA < params$nFeature_RNA_max & 
                                        percent.mt < params$percent.mt_max)

print(paste("Cells post-filtering:",length(colnames(seurat_obj.filtered))))
VlnPlot(seurat_obj.filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```

# Save object

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_obj, file = paste(output_dir,"/",sample,".rds",sep=""))
saveRDS(seurat_obj.filtered, file = paste(output_dir,"/",sample,".filtered.rds",sep=""))
```
